reason: An interactive 3D molecular structure viewer that accepts supported molecular files or text and renders them with configurable visual styles.

summaries.zh: 用于加载PDB、SDF、MOL2或MOL分子数据并在会话界面中交互式查看三维结构。
summaries.en: Loads PDB, SDF, MOL2, or MOL data and displays interactive three-dimensional molecular structures in the session interface.

capabilities: Reads molecule data from a user-provided file path
Accepts pasted molecular structure text in PDB, SDF, MOL2, or MOL format
Renders an interactive 3D molecular viewer with rotation, zoom, styling, and coloring controls
Persists viewer payloads for restoration after restart
